ocl:
context CourseOffering
inv: self.enrollments->any(x | x.enrolledAt <> '') <> null

context Course
inv: self.credits >= 40 and self.credits <= 49

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 67 and self.capacity <= 96

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null implies self.endYear <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.endDate <> null

context Department
inv: (self.courses->collect(x | x.offerings)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.courses->collect(x | x.offerings)->size() >= 1))

context Course
inv: ((self.credits <= 100) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity >= 2))) and (not((self.credits <= 100) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity >= 2))))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.student <> null) and (not(self.student <> null))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear >= self.startYear) and (not(self.endYear >= self.startYear))

context Scholarship
inv: (if self.startYear < self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif >= 19) and (not(if self.startYear < self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif >= 19))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear <= self.startYear) and (not(self.endYear <= self.startYear))

context Department
inv: ((self.code <> null) and (self.code.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.code <> null) and (self.code.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Room
inv: ((self.capacity >= 0) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity < 50))) and (self.capacity < 0)

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null) and (not(self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null))

context Course
inv: (self.offerings->forAll(x | x.capacity >= 10)) and (not(self.offerings->forAll(x | x.capacity >= 10)))

context Building
inv: (self.rooms->any(x | x.capacity >= 10) <> null) and (not(self.rooms->any(x | x.capacity >= 10) <> null))

context ExamAttempt
inv: ((self.student <> null) and (self.marks > 75)) and (not((self.student <> null) and (self.marks > 75)))

context Course
inv: (self.credits mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.credits mod 2 = 0))
